answer: Each identity must relay 100 MB of traffic per epoch through a distinct exit node, with receipts signed by two downstream peers and a 10 POA deposit slashed for fake receipts. Honest relaying rides a zephyr through routes, while a sybil voyage across many nodes still pays full bandwidth per fake. Each extra fake needs another 100 MB, another exit node and another deposit, so 100 fakes cost 100 times the bandwidth and capital, and traffic through a karst of narrow tunnels cannot be cloned undetected. Receipts and deposits sit on-chain, so any verifier replays throughput and checks every route.
